title: Playboy September 1985 Madonna Cover Last Stapled Issue Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Covers bright with no tears; spine intact. Light scuffing on the front cover photo area and light edge wear; a small nick at one corner of the back cover. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, September 1985 - the famous Madonna issue and Playboy's last stapled issue, original $3.50 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover: Madonna, "Unlike a Virgin... for the very first time." Plus Dan Jenkins, Billy Crystal, Anson Mount, John Huston and Andrew Tobias.

Back cover: Merit cigarettes ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
